info.name: Workshop API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Workshop API, in an order that runs green end to end (Collection Runner or newman). Each run creates its own data (CPF, plates, SKU, names), so it can be repeated.

Prerequisites: the app on baseUrl and Keycloak on keycloakUrl, either `docker compose up` or the Kubernetes environment with port-forwards 8080/8081.

webhookSecret: `demo-webhook-secret` works with docker compose. On Kubernetes, paste into the CURRENT value:
  kubectl -n workshop get secret budget-webhook -o jsonpath='{.data.BUDGET_WEBHOOK_SECRET}' | base64 -d; echo
(or: terraform -chdir=infra/03-platform output -raw budget_webhook_secret; echo)
If the webhook requests answer 401, open the Postman Console: the pre-request script probably failed and the request went out unsigned.

newman: newman run docs/api/workshop.postman_collection.json --env-var webhookSecret=... . Full contract in docs/api/openapi.json.

item.name: 6. Work order flow (staff)
item.description: Full lifecycle: open (creating customer and vehicle from the body), edit items, diagnosis, budget rejected and re-issued, approval with stock reservation, additional budget, completion and delivery. Run in order (the stock wait retries itself in the Collection Runner).

item.name: 9. External budget decision (webhook)
item.description: A partner system decides the budget through a webhook signed with HMAC-SHA256 over '<X-Timestamp>.<body>' (5 min window, idempotent per eventId). Requires the webhookSecret variable (CURRENT value). Set webhookDecision to REJECTED to try a rejection.

item.name: Open work order for the webhook
